sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "cost_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sale_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "wholesale_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "stock" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "low_stock" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "track_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("track_stock" IN (0, 1)), "image_path" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "contact_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "opening" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_txns" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NULL, "contact_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "contact_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pos', "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "discount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vat" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "delivery_charge" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "paid" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cost_total" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "account_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "ship_name" TEXT NULL, "ship_phone" TEXT NULL, "ship_address" TEXT NULL, "ship_area" TEXT NULL, "ship_city" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sale_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "price" REAL NOT NULL, "cost" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total" REAL NOT NULL, "returned_qty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ref_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "contact_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "discount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "paid" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "account_id" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "purchase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cost" REAL NOT NULL, "total" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_moves" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "account_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shipments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sale_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "courier" TEXT NOT NULL, "consignment_id" TEXT NULL, "tracking_code" TEXT NULL, "tracking_url" TEXT NULL, "courier_status" TEXT NULL, "cod_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fee" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "booked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "raw_json" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fraud_checks" ("phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("phone"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cashier', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
